description: Na₂Li₂CoO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one LiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.58 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.91 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.08 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-38°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.04 Å. Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-55°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.82 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Li, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Li, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Li, and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Li, and one Co atom.
